summary: Skratch provides a comprehensive first look on the test server at all nine new legendary heroes arriving in Season 9. The new roster includes exclusive support, damage, and control units across Fire, Ice, Necrosis, Radiance, Lightning, and Poison elements. Top highlights include Celestine and Sia as game-changing exclusive supports, Syonis offering permanent area defense reduction based on Enlightenment, and Rhyviel providing massive Corrosion scaling and True Damage. Holfast is singled out as an essential priority hero to empower Aura teams alongside Talethia.

heroes.name: Fyrenzur
heroes.note: Provides team-wide Dodge Up II, passive healing and counterattacks when allies dodge, but offers average overall utility.

heroes.name: Longbeau
heroes.verdict: Solid niche support for PvP and PvE
heroes.note: Dispels debuffs via White Rat stacks and reflects non-CC debuffs back to attackers with Black Rat, though lacks direct burst healing.

heroes.name: Celestine
heroes.note: Absorbs damage into permanent ally stat buffs, cleanses, applies Karmic Sin, and reaches peak efficiency at Inspiration 2.

heroes.name: Sia
heroes.note: Stores damage as Mercy for huge party shields, grants Parry, and punishes enemies with Repentance and ultimate energy drain.

heroes.name: Syonis
heroes.verdict: Top pick exclusive Necrosis DPS and debuffer
heroes.note: Passively reduces enemy defense up to 50% to 60% based on Enlightenment without needing debuff checks, completely replacing the need for Witch's Remains.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Generates Aura energy and grants 30% Damage Up and crit buffs to allied Aura heroes, making him a high priority targeting Inspiration 5.

heroes.name: Tallyn
heroes.verdict: Monster control tank for PvP and MagiChess
heroes.note: Features heavy crowd control through repeated stuns, knock-ups, and a Gatekeeper effect that continually stuns nearby foes.

heroes.name: Amalfriede
heroes.note: Offers multi-debuff chances and Silence, but self-stacking damage increases do not make up for low overall impact.

heroes.name: Rhyviel
heroes.note: Shreds defense, directly magnifies total target Corrosion by a percentage, and deals massive True Damage through hound clones.

meta_changes: Syonis introduces passive area defense reduction scaled by Enlightenment, bypassing the need for artifact debuffers like Witch's Remains.
Holfast and Rhyviel heavily boost the viability of dedicated Aura and Corrosion archetype team compositions.
tips: If building an Aura team, prioritize pulling and ascending Holfast to Inspiration 5 to maximize team Radiant damage and vulnerability.
Target Inspiration 2 on Celestine for a permanent 15% team damage reduction and 15% damage bonus.
Build Syonis with very high Enlightenment to cap out his passive defense reduction aura at 50% (or 60% at Inspiration 5).
title: WHO TO PULL FOR?? Season 9 Brings 9 New Heroes... Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
